implementation: The production service worker precaches only index.html and immutable content-hashed JavaScript/CSS shell assets, treats /api/ as NetworkOnly with no-store fetch semantics, and removes outdated precaches on activation.

The PWA session synchronizer coalesces visibility, pageshow, online, and stream-close signals into bounded jittered recovery, cancels stale generations, fetches an authoritative snapshot before reopening live updates, and stops after five retries.
The product continuity rail receives owner-scoped synchronizer state so connected, reconnecting, offline, and revoked presentation cannot diverge from the route content.
Todo 14 production QA runs on an isolated port and records 24 current screenshots across 375, 768, and 1280 widths in light and dark themes for ready, reconnecting, offline, and revoked states.
